objective: Add status filter tabs with counts and a sort menu to the dashboard, and fix the invisible unselected Grid / List button.
deliverable: Reviewable pull request with passing tests; no merge or deployment.
requirements: Change src/lib/library-search.ts, src/app/dashboard/page.tsx and src/app/dashboard/library-browser.css exactly as specified in the acceptance test header, using anchored edits. Do not change the helper modules.

Helper exports to use exactly as quoted. From "@/lib/library-status": LIBRARY_STAGES (readonly ["uninspected","prepared","approved"]); type LibraryStageFilter = "all" | stage; normalizeLibraryStage(raw: string | string[] | undefined): LibraryStageFilter | null; filterLibraryItemsByStage<T>(rows: readonly T[], filter: LibraryStageFilter): T[]; countLibraryItemsByStage(rows): Record<LibraryStageFilter, number>; libraryStageLabel(filter: LibraryStageFilter): string. From "@/lib/library-sort": LIBRARY_SORTS (readonly ["newest","oldest","name","size"]); type LibrarySort; normalizeLibrarySort(raw: string | string[] | undefined): LibrarySort | null; librarySortLabel(sort: LibrarySort): string; sortLibraryItems<T>(rows: readonly T[], sort: LibrarySort): T[]; pageLibraryItems<T>(rows: readonly T[], rawPage: string | string[] | undefined): { items: T[]; page: number; pageCount: number } | null.

page.tsx: keep the search results in a variable, compute counts from them, filter by stage, then for sort "newest" call the existing paginateLibraryItems on the filtered rows; for other sorts use pageLibraryItems(sortLibraryItems(filteredRows, sort), params.page). Treat an invalid status or sort like invalid pagination input (the existing load-failure alert). Build const view = { q, status, sort } and pass ...view to every libraryPageHref call (with cursor/direction/page as needed). Add hidden status/sort inputs to the search form when not default; add the tabs nav and a GET sort form (label "Sort by", select id="library-sort" name="sort", submit button "Sort", hidden q and status inputs) right after the search form; add Previous / Next page links inside the existing Library pages nav for numbered pages. The empty state for a search or status view links to libraryPageHref({ q: "", cursor: null, direction: null }).

library-search.ts: extend LibraryPageHrefInput with optional status?: string, sort?: string, page?: number (defaults "all", "newest", 1) and set them in the order q, status, sort, page, cursor, direction only when not default.

library-browser.css: append .view-toggle button[aria-pressed="false"] { color: var(--ink); }, .status-tabs { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5rem; margin: 0.75rem 0; }, .status-tabs a (pill: padding, 1px var(--line) border, 999px radius, no underline, small text), .status-tabs a[aria-current="page"] { background: var(--accent); border-color: var(--accent); color: #fff; } and .sort-form { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; }.
